description: List customer conversations across every connected channel (Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and comments, Telegram, OLX, Prom, eBay, Threads replies, the B2B portal, buyer order pages …). One row per lead and channel, newest first: { leadId, leadName, channel, lastMessageAt, lastMessageText (first 300 characters), lastDirection (inbound = from the customer), awaitingReply (the customer wrote last) } plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Open conversations only — converted or disqualified leads and closed threads are left out. Filter by channel, by awaitingReply, or by a text match on the customer's name or last message. Read-only: replies are written by a person in the CRM Inbox, this server cannot send messages. Use get_lead_conversation to read one thread's messages and get_lead for the lead card.

awaitingReply.description: True returns only conversations whose last message is from the customer and still wait for an answer.

channel.description: Channel slug to keep, as returned in the channel field of earlier results (e.g. instagram, telegram, olx). Omit for all channels.

query.description: Text to match against the customer's name or the last message.

name: list_conversations
